title: Canonical restriction-to-stalk comparison on complexes
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $y \in Y$, and $V$ an open neighbourhood of $y$. Let $R_V$ be restriction to $V$, $S_V$ pullback along $V.\mathrm{fromSpecStalkOfMem}(y)$, and $T$ pullback along $Y.\mathrm{fromSpecStalk}(y)$, applied termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Define the natural isomorphism $E_V:R_V S_V\cong T$ by replacing restriction with pullback along the inclusion [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], composing pullbacks, and using the equality of the composite scheme map with $Y.\mathrm{fromSpecStalk}(y)$. This specifies the comparison itself, including its direction.

def stalkRestrictionComplexIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens)
    (y : Y) (hyV : y ∈ V) :
    (restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≅
      (Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
